contract.name: dictate-platform
contract.implementation_claim: This is a Dictate-side planning and handoff artifact. It locks proposed authorities and contracts for Waves 1-3; no shared backend or live service is claimed to conform.

identity.entitlement_role: paid offering, plan, entitlement, and capability set; not an account identity
identity.separation_rule: Dictate is the product and product space. Dictate Pro is its paid offering and entitlement. Arc Forge owns the account identity.

origin.route_binding: Every public operation URL is the locked HTTPS origin followed by exactly one route path; the origin is already scheme-qualified and is never interpolated into another scheme.

rendering.public_operation_url_rule: url_template equals origin + route, with exactly one scheme delimiter

origin.deployment_verification_task: verify canonical HTTPS origin, proxy routing, and non-Deck product return before Wave 1 release

non_loopback_gateway.selection_rule: A non-loopback base URL selects the current Arc Forge gateway compatibility paths.

current_v1_reference.label: local or explicitly selected legacy /v1 compatibility; not a production authority
current_v1_reference.transport: local/reference server or explicit legacy mode
current_v1_reference.allowed_use: local tests, reference behavior, and bounded migration compatibility only

authority_map.decision_rule: Every production surface has exactly one proposed authority. UNKNOWN describes deployment verification, not an unresolved implementation choice.

desktop_local_and_client_compatibility.disposition: Dictate owns local-first UX, client routing, local secrets, and bounded /api-to-/v1 compatibility.

arc_forge_identity_and_auth.disposition: Canonical owner for account_id, email fallback, PKCE/browser consent, device authorization, tokens, refresh, and discovery.

dictate_commerce_and_entitlement.disposition: Canonical owner for Stripe checkout/webhook projection, Dictate subscription, and dictate_pro entitlement; Deck commerce semantics remain separate.

dictate_devices.disposition: Canonical owner for device registration, consent/approval, current-device recovery, and revocation.

dictate_encrypted_sync.owner_role: external shared backend owner plus Dictate client
dictate_encrypted_sync.disposition: Backend owns durable envelopes/cursors/key-envelope delivery; Dictate owns client-side encryption and explicit sync consent.

dictate_hosted_jobs_and_results.disposition: Canonical owner for durable jobs, uploads, worker handoff, artifact retrieval/ack/deletion, and owner isolation.

dictate_usage.disposition: Canonical audio-second ledger for Dictate; Deck usage is a separate product ledger.

governed_provider_neutral_stt_gateway.disposition: One governed server-side provider boundary; provider/model aliases and credentials never become client authority.

dictate_product_surface.owner_role: Dictate implementation lane; Deck UI remains separate
dictate_product_surface.disposition: Dictate owns product copy and return destination; it does not own Arc Forge identity or shared commerce policy.

source_flow_manifest.purpose: Compact source-connected completeness manifest for current and permanently required flows; it is not an exhaustive archaeology list.

LoopbackRedirectURI.description: RFC 8252 loopback callback: http, literal 127.0.0.1 or [::1], valid non-zero port 1-65535, exact /callback, and no query, fragment, or userinfo.

deleted.description: Legacy alias; canonical tombstone is authoritative.

SyncAuthenticatedMetadata.description: AAD binds the ciphertext to the account, originating device, collection, record, revision, and tombstone bit.

DeviceKeyEnvelope.description: Current src/dictate/sync.py X25519 ephemeral wrapping envelope; account and recipient device scope are supplied by the authenticated record.

RecoveryKeyEnvelope.description: Current src/dictate/sync.py PBKDF2 recovery envelope; the recovery key remains client-held and the account-bound AAD is not a free-form field.

KeyEnvelopeRequest.description: The authenticated account is the account scope; this wrapper matches the current client/service transport.

invariants: event_id is immutable, unique, and never reused
amount and quantity are numeric audio-second values and must be equal
reserve, settle, rollback, and reject events share request_id, job_id, idempotency_key, period, and correlation_id
settlement quantity cannot exceed the reservation quantity for the same correlation_id and predecessor
duplicate retry returns the existing event/outcome for the same idempotency_key without a second ledger mutation
rollback is exactly-once per predecessor and never mutates the original event

provider_alias.description: Server-selected alias; not a client credential.

model_alias.description: Server-selected model alias; not a client credential.

GatewayInvocation.privacy: audio is permitted only on this governed provider-request surface and bounded worker path; it is forbidden in logs, sync, support exports, and analytics.

GatewayUsageOutcome.description: A gateway response links one settlement, rollback, or rejection event to its durable reservation correlation.

Error.privacy: details must not include tokens, provider credentials, audio, or readable transcript text

cross_event_invariants: A retry with the same account_id, request_id, job_id, idempotency_key, and event_type returns the original immutable event.
A settlement is accepted only once and its quantity is no greater than the correlated reservation.
A rollback has one predecessor and exactly one effective reversal; duplicate rollback delivery is a no-op.
All lifecycle events remain in the same account and usage period; Deck events cannot satisfy Dictate ledger predicates.

rows.proof: No provider credential or public-native client secret is client-visible.

rows.retention: protocol TTL; refresh token rotation and revocation; secure native storage only
rows.proof: Token use is limited to the auth protocol and OS-backed native storage.

rows.retention: explicit upload and processing TTL, then deletion on terminal outcome or expiry
rows.proof: Raw audio is not backup or sync data and is deleted after the bounded processing window.

rows.retention: provider request lifetime plus bounded processing TTL; delete after terminal outcome or expiry
rows.proof: The gateway may carry audio only as a governed server-side STT request; it is not a general model or backup surface.

rows.retention: request-scoped memory only; encrypt immediately into the owner-bound artifact, then delete readable provider response data
rows.proof: The governed worker may process a provider response in bounded memory solely to produce the authenticated owner-bound encrypted handoff; no response persistence or telemetry surface is permitted.

rows.retention: bounded artifact lifetime; delete after acknowledgement or TTL
rows.proof: Readable transcript exists only for client delivery or the encrypted result handoff, then is deleted after ack/TTL.

idempotency.replay_semantics: The same account, operation, and key returns the original outcome without duplicate side effects.

ledger_invariants: A duplicate gateway retry with the same account_id and idempotency_key returns the original reservation and outcome without a second mutation.
Settlement quantity must be no greater than the correlated reservation and may be accepted only once.
Rollback requires the reservation predecessor and exactly one effective reversal; duplicate rollback delivery is rejected or a no-op, never a second reversal.
A provider failure or quota rejection still produces a linked rejection or rollback outcome.

requirements.account_isolation: Every entitlement, commerce, device, sync, job, result, and usage read/write is authorized against account_id.

durability.auth_state: durable across process restart and rolling deploy
durability.device_state: durable and revocation-aware across refresh, sync, and hosted jobs
durability.hosted_job_state: durable worker-owned state with restart-safe polling
durability.result_handoff: worker completion is separate from client delivery and acknowledgement

proofs_required: worker completion survives a lost client response
duplicate retrieval returns the same owner-bound artifact
expiry and deletion remove raw audio and readable result material
support/log/analytics surfaces contain no readable transcript

account_bound_aad.encoding: exact UTF-8 bytes after trimming account_id; no alternate normalization or caller-supplied AAD

error_shape.privacy_rule: Error details must not include tokens, provider credentials, audio, or readable transcript text.

local_client.api_selection: _uses_arcforge_gateway selects /api for non-loopback URLs and explicit arcforge/gateway/hosted modes; local/legacy selects /v1
local_client.verification: source and tests; no released client count claimed

external_source_snapshot.authority_role: owner authority candidate only; not a deployed-conformance claim
